scope: Independent mathematical mapping of ordinary full-row encoding to compiled normalized_small_two_dirty; not a Lean formalization of the Python encoder

hypothesis_mapping.IsAO2: AND/OR op bit plus exactly two selected backward sources; output is last gate.
hypothesis_mapping.full_correctness: All52 minimal true and704 maximal false rows are encoded; AND/OR monotonicity and boundary completeness imply the full incidence function.
hypothesis_mapping.BelowF_and_clean: A monotone gate is below the target iff it is false on all704 maximal-false inputs; clean flags encode both directions exactly.
hypothesis_mapping.live: Every nonfinal gate has a later reader. Finite strictly increasing reader paths terminate at the final output, giving InOutputCone for every gate.
hypothesis_mapping.NoSoundOperands: Line179 prevents every clean gate wire from feeding an AND. A primary is not below the graph function because its singleton input is false for the target. Backward sources exclude nonexistent wires.
hypothesis_mapping.IsLiftFixedPoint: Line180 forces an OR reading a clean gate wire to be clean itself. Primary operands are never implicants. Thus no dirty OR can read an implicant wire, so no LiftAt exists.
hypothesis_mapping.dirty_count: New flag is exactly AND and not clean; the threshold2 recurrence counts distinct gate indices.

Previously reviewed other normalizations remain separate obligations.
